ZMB.note: Gridded population release uses building footprints from satellite imagery; no farming use stated.

facts.fact: WorldPop and the Zambia Statistics Agency state that household locations and ward-level population counts were collected during the Zambia 2022 Census of Population and Housing.

The release states that ward-level population counts from the 2022 Census preliminary results, published by the Zambia Statistics Agency, were used to build the gridded estimates released on 4 June 2024.
